title: Wartime Austin: Red Cross & Cab Drivers
summary:
*   City leaders officially proclaimed March 15 to April 1 as the period for raising the Red Cross War Fund quota for Austin and Travis County, supporting the national wartime effort.
*   Numerous new taxicab driver permits were approved, including applications from several individuals explicitly noted as "colored" in the records.
*   Dozens of existing taxicab driver permits were renewed, indicating a busy and vital local transportation sector during the war.

REGULAR MEETING OF THE CITY COUNCIL:
Austin, Texas, March 11, 1943
The City Council convened in regular session, at the regular mecting place in the Council
Chamber at the Municipal Building, on Thursday, March 11, 1943, at 11:00 A. M., with the
following members presents Councilmen Alford, Bartholomew, and Gillis; absent, Mayor
Miller and Councilman Wolf.
There were present also: Walter E. Seaholm, Acting City Manager; J. E. Motheral, City
Engineer; and R. D. Thorp, Chief of Police.
1
